recognition.summary: ASUS publishes a central Hall of Fame for security contributors.

reporting.summary: The full policy links ASUS's own vulnerability-reporting form.

rewards.summary: The policy says requests for vulnerability-related compensation will not be considered.

limitations: The form itself could not be read; its first-party route is documented by the reviewed policy.
Reports must remain confidential; the policy prohibits unauthorized access or modification.
